# elevenlabs_workspace_webhook (Resource)

Manages an ElevenLabs workspace webhook. Webhooks receive event callbacks (e.g. post-call transcripts) from ElevenLabs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the webhook.
- `webhook_url` (String)

### Optional

- `auth_type` (String)
- `is_disabled` (Boolean)
- `retry_enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `created_at_unix` (Number)
- `id` (String) ElevenLabs webhook ID (assigned on create).
- `is_auto_disabled` (Boolean)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive)
